snippet.title: Pixelarium: Free Lands - Teaser
snippet.description:
Explore the Free Lands of Pixelarium in this retro open-world Roguelike RPG. 

Customize your hero with unique gear and powerful abilities, battle deadly creatures in fast-paced turn-based combat, and uncover the secrets hidden throughout your journey. 

Will you survive?

WISHLIST ON STEAM
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3208450/Pixelarium_Free_Lands
